content: Direction detection approaches: simplest robust rule is majority of buffer letters belong to one alphabet (what most converters do); Punto uses statistical analysis plus dictionaries of letter combinations impossible in a language; academic word-level language ID uses character n-gram/digram frequency and per-word probabilities (Microsoft LID-tool, code-mixed text literature). For EN/RU the scripts are disjoint so script counting suffices for direction; the hard part is mixed-text segmentation - langSwitcher approach: select to line start, find where wrong layout begins, convert whole phrase; spec semantics: correct only portion not in the layout relative to last used.
